## Pull request overview

Fixes CI failures on `main` by aligning the lockfile with Studio’s workspace dependencies and updating `service-ai` stream encoder tests to the current Vercel AI SDK v6 SSE UI Message Stream Protocol.

**Changes:**
- Regenerated `pnpm-lock.yaml` to include `@objectstack/service-ai@workspace:*` under `apps/studio` importers (fixes `--frozen-lockfile` CI failures).
- Updated `vercel-stream-encoder` unit tests to assert v6 SSE framing and the required stream lifecycle preamble/postamble.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 1 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Adds missing `@objectstack/service-ai` workspace link for `apps/studio`, unblocking frozen-lockfile installs in CI. |
| packages/services/service-ai/src/__tests__/vercel-stream-encoder.test.ts | Updates assertions to match v6 SSE `data: ...\n\n` frames and lifecycle ordering emitted by the encoder. |
